note: Copy to confluence-spaces.json and fill in your settings.
spaces: space keys appear in the URL — /display/SPACEKEY/Page+Title
exclude_title_patterns: regex strings matched against page titles (case-insensitive). Pages whose titles match are always skipped. Useful for sprint ceremony pages, auto-generated reports, etc.
my_context_keywords: your primary product/project names. Used together with skip_if_only_mentions.

skip_if_only_mentions: other products/teams that are noisy for you. A page is skipped if its title+excerpt mentions any of these keywords but NONE of my_context_keywords. If it mentions both (cross-product discussion), it surfaces normally. @mention pages are never filtered regardless of keywords.
